# The source skeleton nests several levels deep and its stored deltas are PARENT-RELATIVE.
# These records have that hierarchy already collapsed: each key is the single rotation +
# translation that maps the bone's REST geometry to its posed position, so a renderer with
# no skeleton (independent rigid parts) can apply one transform per part per frame.

# Read with a plain find("%S+") tokenizer; split lines with a PLAIN find, not a pattern.
